delta.note: PMK 54/2025 amends PMK 81/2024 (Coretax) only to adjust tax provisions on bullion business, gold bar imports and crypto asset trading transactions. It deletes related definitions, articles and appendix items (OOO, EEEE). It does not change any rate, threshold, table, deduction or calculation step for PPh 21 on permanent employees.
